H-A6-UPSTREAM.name: Upstream Origin of Model-Resolvable Correctness
H-A6-UPSTREAM.question: Does model-resolvable correctness primarily originate before the Motif Graph?

evidence.finding: Pixel Readout (S0) alone transfers virtually no correctness (<2.2%). However, the Spatial Motif Composer (S1) establishes a substantial foundation, transferring ~36% of the correct classification signal.

H-A6-EARLY-MOTIF.name: Early Motif Graph Divergence (Layers 1-2)
H-A6-EARLY-MOTIF.question: Does correctness diverge mainly in Motif layers 1–2?

evidence.swap_rescue_increase: S1 (36.4%) -> S2 (46.7%) -> S3 (57.8%), adding +21.4% rescue across Layers 1 and 2
evidence.first_rescue_accumulation: By Layer 2 (R3), 81.3% of V21-correct and 80.5% of V22-correct samples have established positive true-class margin
evidence.paired_delta_margin: Jumps from +0.519 at R1 to +1.107 at R3 (more than doubling)
evidence.finding: Motif Layers 1-2 represent the highest-velocity discriminative separation zone in the entire MPG architecture.

H-A6-MID-LATE-MOTIF.name: Mid-to-Late Motif Graph Reasoning (Layers 3-5)
H-A6-MID-LATE-MOTIF.question: Does correctness diverge mainly in Motif layers 3–5?

evidence.swap_rescue_increase: S3 (57.8%) -> S6 (71.3%), adding +13.5% further rescue across Layers 3-5
evidence.finding: Mid-to-late Motif layers provide steady cumulative refinement (+13.5% rescue), reinforcing early separation rather than initiating it.

H-A6-READOUT-HEAD.name: Readout and Decision Head Bottleneck
H-A6-READOUT-HEAD.question: Does useful true-class signal survive into Motif/Fusion but final decision fails downstream?

evidence.finding: Motif readout pooling and Fusion capture 90% of the entire classification decision. The downstream MLP classifier head adds almost no divergence (+1.2%), ruling out the decision head as a primary bottleneck.

H-A6-ROUTING-LINK.name: Routing Support Association with Representation Divergence
H-A6-ROUTING-LINK.question: Are routing-support differences systematically associated with model-resolvable representation differences?

evidence.minimum_support_jaccard: Support Jaccard reaches its lowest point in Layer 4 (0.274) and Layer 3 (0.282), directly coinciding with the peak region of representation rescue accumulation
evidence.finding: Sample-conditioned dynamic routing differences are functionally linked to representation divergence, but serve as an integral mechanism of the GNN rather than an isolated knob.

H-A6-SINGLE-BOTTLENECK.name: Single Dominant Bottleneck Hypothesis
H-A6-SINGLE-BOTTLENECK.question: Is there one dominant stage explaining most model-resolvable errors?

evidence.distributed_rescue_profile: S1 (Upstream Composer) = 36.4%; S1->S3 (Early Motif) = +21.4%; S3->S6 (Mid/Late Motif) = +13.5%; S6->S7 (Readout Pooling) = +18.1%
evidence.finding: Model-resolvable failures are distributed across the pipeline: upstream composition sets the initial 36% foundation, early motif reasoning adds 21%, mid/late motif adds 14%, and readout adds 18%.

rationale: No single module accounts for the majority of model-resolvable divergence.

Upstream Spatial Motif Composer initiates ~36% of the discriminative signal, Early Motif reasoning (Layers 1-2) contributes +21%, Mid/Late Motif reasoning (Layers 3-5) adds +14%, and Motif Readout pooling captures +18%.
Swapping intermediate representations reproducibly transfers correctness in both directions (reaching 90.6% at Fusion).
Pixel readout alone accounts for virtually zero rescue (<2.2%), and the classifier head accounts for only +1.2% marginal change.
Interventions must target distributed representation preservation across composition, relational propagation, and multi-token pooling.
